output.reason: [ev-e6df95267b63] says Kyverno's wildcard view permissions were removed and replaced with a binding to the system view role. It also says this may affect mutate and generate policies on custom resources and policy-result reporting for validation rules on custom resources. A Helm option was added so Kyverno can be upgraded "without breaking existing policies", which means exposed setups break if the operator does nothing. The renders confirm that */*:get/list/watch was dropped from the admission, background and reports controller ClusterRoles [ev-6af5be55b5f4][ev-0ae726bec846][ev-fbb2a078179b]. A component losing access it relies on is permission-lost, not behavior-change; confidence is low because upstream says "may".

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the wildcard view permissions from its controllers and binds them to the system view role instead. Without the new Helm upgrade option, mutate and generate policies on custom resources, and reporting of validation results on custom resources, may break.

consequence.statement: Kyverno's controllers lose their wildcard view (get/list/watch) access and keep only the system view role. Admission-control policy behaviour is not affected. Mutate and generate policies for custom resources, and policy-result reporting for validation rules on custom resources, may break if the Helm option is not used.
consequence.remediation: Follow the Kyverno 1.13 upgrade guidance. Either set the Helm option added to upgrade without breaking existing policies, or grant Kyverno's controllers view access to the custom resources your policies target.
